items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: I'll tell you who can probably give you a little more idea about that band, more better than me, cause he'd come down the Creole part of the town. That's, uh, uh, what you call, uh, Harold. Harold Dejon.

ctx.x: Yeah, it must have been a good time. Uh, that Blaze Away band, you say, was a downtown band?

Downtown, I'll tell you now, I'll tell you who can probably give you a little more idea about that band, more better than me, cause he'd come down the Creole part of the town. That's, uh, uh, what you call, uh, Harold. Harold Dejon.
Harold Dejon. We see him quite often, yeah.
